statement: Complete finite-subgroup catalogues for extended mapping class groups of genus two with one and two punctures:32 and121 conjugacy classes; positive portions10 and23. Exact intrinsic fixed-stratum decorations, normalizer fusion, section posets, multipliers, centralizers and stabilizers.
manuscript_passages: Part B(f) of the task; no further manuscript assertion
notes: Uses intrinsic K strata, permitting punctures to move through noncritical Weierstrass points. Full normalizer permutations proved via colored cone/boundary symmetries, character-sheet monodromy and independent pure-braid sheet interchanges. All positive rows independently agree with B33 on five section invariants; negative involution counts4,11 agree with B16.
